creatures.description: A plump little pig with a pug's expressive brown eyes, floppy ears and dark muzzle. Its pink pig snout, tiny hooves and curled pig tail keep its farm identity clear.

creatures.name: Dalmootian
creatures.description: A fluffy little calf with soft black-and-white Dalmatian markings and long floppy ears. Small cow horns, a broad pink muzzle, cloven hooves and a tufted tail complete its friendly silhouette.

creatures.name: Horsaroo
creatures.description: A chestnut pony with a tousled dark mane, upright kangaroo ears and powerful hind legs. Small hoofed forelimbs rest beside its cream chest, while a thick kangaroo tail balances its rounded body.

creatures.name: Alpanda
creatures.description: A cloud-soft alpaca with a long neck, rounded black panda ears and gentle panda eye patches. Cream fleece, a dark shoulder band, black lower legs and a little fluffy tail make its two animal parents easy to recognise.

creatures.name: Woolrus
creatures.description: A round sheep wrapped in thick cream curls, with a broad walrus muzzle, soft whiskers and two small ivory tusks. Four short legs end in cloven sheep hooves, and a tiny woolly tail peeks out at the back.
creatures.notes: Selected as the farm's sheep hybrid. New measurements, endangered status and egg artwork are still to be decided.

creatures.name: Baaboon
creatures.description: An upright sheep-baboon hybrid with warm brown curly wool, lighter tan cheeks and chest, a friendly baboon muzzle and a curved monkey tail. It walks on two cloven sheep-hoofed feet and has two arms ending in monkey hands.
creatures.notes: Scrapped sheep concept. Woolrus is the selected Farmland creature. This latest Baaboon design includes brown wool and upright walking.

review.note: Model appearance and gameplay review pending.

creatures.name: Pisangitang
creatures.description: A curved banana-shaped creature with banana-yellow skin beneath shaggy orange orangutan fur. Thick fur covers its body and back, leaving its friendly face, broad hands and feet exposed, with small glimpses of yellow skin between the fur. Long arms and short legs complete its playful silhouette.
creatures.notes: Retained in the concept and rejected creature collection at Daniel's request on 25 October 2026. The latest concept has a whole unpeeled banana body, dense fur especially across the back, and no separate banana on its head. No region, measurements or conservation status have been assigned. The egg study is included in the concept sheet.
